tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Properties of Integrals of Forms] 1. chB:B.20Suppose $M$ and $N$ are nonempty oriented smooth $n$-manifolds with or without boundary, and $\omega , \eta $ are compactly supported $n$-forms on $M$.

  1. LINEARITY: If $a, b \in \mathbb {R}$, then

    \[ \int _M (a\omega + b\eta ) = a \int _M \omega + b \int _M \eta . \]

  2. ORIENTATION REVERSAL: If $-M$ denotes $M$ with the opposite orientation, then

    \[ \int _{-M} \omega = -\int _M \omega . \]

  3. POSITIVITY: If $\omega $ is a positively oriented orientation form, then $\int _M \omega > 0$.

  4. DIFFEOMORPHISM INVARIANCE: If $F: N \to M$ is an orientation-preserving or orientation-reversing diffeomorphism, then

    \[ \int _M \omega = \begin{cases} \int _N F^*\omega & \text{if } F \text{ is orientation-preserving,} \\ -\int _N F^*\omega & \text{if } F \text{ is orientation-reversing.} \end{cases} \]
